title: Lighthouse 100
summary: EDS projects start at a mobile and desktop Lighthouse score of 100 from the boilerplate. It is hard to win back once lost, so every change is tested against PageSpeed Insights before it merges.

items.title: Score 100 on .aem.live
items.detail: Run PageSpeed Insights on the .aem.live URL and get 100 on mobile and desktop.

items.title: PR test URLs
items.detail: List test URLs in the PR description so the AEM bot runs PageSpeed Insights and fails a low score.

items.title: 100 KB to LCP
items.detail: Keep markup, CSS, JS and the LCP image below about 100 KB in total before LCP shows.

items.title: One origin before LCP
items.detail: Load nothing from a second origin before LCP; each extra connection adds TLS and DNS delay.

items.title: No preload hints
items.detail: Remove preload links, fetchpriority, preconnect, early hints and h2-push; they spend the LCP bandwidth budget.

items.title: Content in the markup
items.detail: Render canonical content on the server; fetch JSON on the client only for lists, apps and other non-canonical content.

items.title: No redirect chains
items.detail: Send visitors straight to the final URL instead of hopping from / to /en to /en/home.

items.title: Score 100 in production
items.detail: Rerun PageSpeed Insights on the production domain after the CDN goes live and compare it with .aem.live.

items.title: Watch field data
items.detail: Use Operational Telemetry to confirm Core Web Vitals in the field, since lab and real-device numbers differ.

title: Eager, lazy, delayed
summary: EDS splits every page load into three phases: eager (up to LCP), lazy (first-party sections, blocks and styles) and delayed (consented martech). Code in the wrong phase is the most common cause of a lost Lighthouse score.

items.title: Body hidden until ready
items.detail: Keep body display:none in styles.css until decoration adds the appear class, so no image loads early.

items.title: Lean first section
items.detail: Put few blocks in the first section; all of its blocks load before LCP can show.

items.title: Right LCP candidate
items.detail: Make the first image of the first section the real LCP, or let the block set it before loading picks one.

items.title: Header and footer lazy
items.detail: Load header and footer as blocks in the lazy phase, not in the markup or the eager path.

items.title: Post-LCP CSS deferred
items.detail: Put global CSS that is not needed for LCP in lazy-styles.css, which loads after LCP.

items.title: Libraries per block
items.detail: Load third-party libraries with loadScript() in the block that needs them, not in head.html.

items.title: Martech in consented.js
items.detail: Load analytics, tag managers and other martech only from consented.js after consent-check.js grants consent.

items.title: Delay after LCP
items.detail: Start the delayed phase at least three seconds after LCP; add that wait yourself, the boilerplate no longer does.

title: head.html
summary: head.html is injected verbatim into every page's <head> after the metadata from content. It is on the critical path of every page, so it should stay close to the boilerplate.

items.title: Close to boilerplate
items.detail: Keep head.html largely unchanged; legit edits are a different code base path or legacy browser support.

items.title: Three entry points
items.detail: Reference aem.js, scripts.js and styles.css, which together must stay small enough to reach LCP fast.

items.title: No martech in head
items.detail: Keep Web SDK, Google Tag Manager and other third-party scripts out of head.html.

items.title: No inline code
items.detail: Do not add inline scripts or styles; put code in scripts.js, styles.css or a block.

items.title: No preload links
items.detail: Leave out preload and preconnect links, including font preloads; they slow LCP in PageSpeed Insights.

items.title: Nonce on scripts
items.detail: Mark each trusted script tag with nonce="aem" so AEM can swap in a random nonce for the CSP.

items.title: Subfolder paths match
items.detail: When AEM serves only a folder such as /en/blog/, point the script and style paths at that folder.

items.title: Repoless head in config
items.detail: For repoless sites, store head.html in the site configuration instead of the repo.

title: Web fonts
summary: EDS loads web fonts after LCP and paints first with a size-adjusted system font, so the swap causes no layout shift. Preloading fonts or blocking on them costs the Lighthouse score.

items.title: Fonts in fonts.css
items.detail: Declare @font-face rules in styles/fonts.css, not styles.css, so scripts.js loads them after the first section.

items.title: Never preload fonts
items.detail: Do not preload fonts by link, early hints or h2-push; aem.live calls it counterproductive.

items.title: Size-adjusted fallback
items.detail: Define a fallback @font-face on a local font with size-adjust so text keeps its size when the font swaps.

items.title: Fallback after custom font
items.detail: List the fallback family right after the custom font in each font-family stack.

items.title: Measure with the extension
items.detail: Compute size-adjust values with the font-fallback Chrome extension, averaged over several pages.

items.title: Set line-height
items.detail: Set line-height on text so height does not depend on the font.

items.title: Trim the font kit
items.detail: Load only the font faces the site uses; unused weights in a kit waste bytes.

items.title: Swap with woff2
items.detail: Use font-display: swap and woff2 files, as the boilerplate fonts.css does.

title: Images & media
summary: EDS serves authored images and short videos through the Media Bus: same origin, content-addressed and resized on the fly. Most image wins come from authoring and from keeping the LCP image on that path.

items.title: Images via Media Bus
items.detail: Paste or upload images in content so they ship from the same origin as media_ URLs, not from the repo.

items.title: No binaries in GitHub
items.detail: Keep content images out of the code repo; commit an SVG only when code references it.

items.title: Width and height kept
items.detail: Keep the width and height that EDS puts on each img, including when a block rebuilds the picture.

items.title: Pictures via helper
items.detail: Build pictures in JS with createOptimizedPicture() from aem.js for webp sources and widths.

items.title: Lazy except LCP
items.detail: Leave images lazy; aem.js switches the first image of the first section to eager.

items.title: One hero image
items.detail: When content has desktop and mobile heroes, remove the unused one so it never loads.

items.title: Alt text by role
items.detail: Write alt text for informative images and use an empty alt for decorative ones.

items.title: Short video with poster
items.detail: Upload short hero videos as MP4 with a poster image; host long videos on a DAM or streaming service.

items.title: Same-origin DAM images
items.detail: If images link to a DAM, route that DAM through the production CDN so the LCP image stays same-origin.

title: Custom headers & CSP
summary: EDS sets custom HTTP response headers from the headers object in site configuration, and the boilerplate ships a nonce-based Content Security Policy. Both apply to preview and live, so mistakes reach authors too.

items.title: Headers in site config
items.detail: Set response headers in the headers object of the site configuration, keyed by URL glob.

items.title: Tight glob patterns
items.detail: Scope each header with a glob such as /fragments/** instead of applying it site-wide.

items.title: No wildcard CORS
items.detail: Avoid access-control-allow-origin: *; allow one origin, or limit the header to specific URLs.

items.title: Code headers need sync
items.detail: Expect headers on code resources to apply only after the next code sync.

items.title: Strict CSP policy
items.detail: Use script-src 'nonce-aem' 'strict-dynamic' with base-uri 'self' and object-src 'none'.

items.title: Nonce on static HTML
items.detail: Add nonce="aem" to trusted scripts in head.html and in static files such as 404.html.

items.title: CSP as a header
items.detail: Trial the CSP as a meta tag in a branch, then move it to a header via site config.

items.title: No document.write
items.detail: Avoid document.write and createContextualFragment; the cached nonce does not protect them.

items.title: Current Cloudflare worker
items.detail: On Cloudflare, run the latest worker so 304 responses drop the CSP header.

wild.note: Edit site headers in the browser

title: BYO CDN
summary: A production domain on EDS sits behind a CDN, either Adobe-managed or your own Fastly, Akamai, Cloudflare or CloudFront. The CDN must forward the right headers and honor origin caching, or pages go stale or slow.

items.title: Origin is main branch
items.detail: Point the CDN at https://main--<site>--<org>.aem.live for production.

items.title: X-Forwarded-Host sent
items.detail: Send X-Forwarded-Host with the production domain on every origin request.

items.title: Push invalidation on
items.detail: Register the CDN in the site's production CDN config and send X-Push-Invalidation: enabled.

items.title: Purge keys as secrets
items.detail: Store purge credentials as secrets and reference them from the CDN config.

items.title: Origin controls caching
items.detail: Honor origin Cache-Control headers and enable gzip compression.

items.title: Query strings in key
items.detail: Forward query parameters to the origin and include them in the cache key.

items.title: Age header stripped
items.detail: Remove the Age response header or force Age: 0.

items.title: HTTP to HTTPS
items.detail: Redirect every HTTP request with a 301 to HTTPS, keeping host, path and query string.

items.title: No CDN add-ons
items.detail: Disable CDN-injected scripts, bot managers and RUM add-ons that slow LCP; recheck PSI after launch.
